title: Control valve diagnostic context
text: Use position, controller diagnostics, pneumatic condition, process context and service history together. Treat friction/stiction, position deviation, abnormal load, supply pressure and device alerts as investigation signals, not standalone proof.

title: Process pump condition context
text: Use vibration, bearing temperature, pressure, flow and motor load together. Look for consistent multivariate changes and verify locally before maintenance work.

title: Electric motor condition context
text: Use vibration, bearing temperature, current/load and operating history. Prefer trend evidence over isolated thresholds.

title: Pressure transmitter validation
text: Assess continuity, drift, signal quality and comparison against process context or a reference measurement.

title: Vibration sensor quality context
text: Assess signal stability, drift, missing data and mounting quality. Poor sensor quality should reduce downstream confidence.

title: Field-service safety guardrail
text: The assistant must not replace site procedures, lockout/tagout, permits, OEM instructions or qualified personnel. Recommend verification and escalation rather than autonomous physical action.

title: Evidence-grounded AI response contract
text: Name the asset, cite telemetry/events/doc IDs, state confidence, distinguish observation from hypothesis, and propose the next safe verification step.

title: 3D scene-to-asset mapping contract
text: Map visible objects to stable asset IDs with explicit confidence. Mapping may use scene hierarchy, annotation, QR/NFC or computer vision. Never silently guess identity.

title: Volute casing (illustrative pump)
text: Volute casing: Collects liquid leaving the impeller and converts velocity into pressure; contains the discharge nozzle. Typical symptoms: internal deposits or fouling narrowing the flow path; erosion / cavitation pitting near the cutwater; external leakage at gasketed joints. Signals: process_pressure_bar, process_flow_pct, motor_current_a.
source: Industrial X-Ray AI educational knowledge base (non-OEM)

title: Impeller (illustrative pump)
text: Impeller: Rotating vaned wheel that adds energy to the liquid; its condition sets the pump's head–flow curve. Typical symptoms: fouling / build-up on vanes → lower flow for the same power; cavitation erosion at vane inlets; imbalance → vibration at 1× running speed. Signals: process_flow_pct, process_pressure_bar, motor_current_a, vibration_mm_s.
source: Industrial X-Ray AI educational knowledge base (non-OEM)

title: Wear ring (illustrative pump)
text: Wear ring: Small running clearance between impeller and casing that limits internal recirculation. Typical symptoms: clearance growth → efficiency loss, lower discharge pressure. Signals: process_pressure_bar, process_flow_pct.
source: Industrial X-Ray AI educational knowledge base (non-OEM)

title: Mechanical seal (illustrative pump)
text: Mechanical seal: Seals the rotating shaft where it leaves the pressurised casing. Typical symptoms: visible leakage at the seal chamber; seal-face heating; dry-running damage. Signals: bearing_temp_c, process_pressure_bar.
source: Industrial X-Ray AI educational knowledge base (non-OEM)

title: Shaft (illustrative pump)
text: Shaft: Transmits torque from the coupling to the impeller; carries the rotating assembly. Typical symptoms: bending or run-out → vibration; fretting at fits. Signals: vibration_mm_s.
source: Industrial X-Ray AI educational knowledge base (non-OEM)

title: Inboard bearing (illustrative pump)
text: Inboard bearing: Supports radial load of the rotating assembly on the pump side. Typical symptoms: rising vibration; rising bearing temperature; noise. Signals: vibration_mm_s, bearing_temp_c.
source: Industrial X-Ray AI educational knowledge base (non-OEM)

title: Outboard bearing (illustrative pump)
text: Outboard bearing: Supports radial and axial load at the drive end of the bearing housing. Typical symptoms: rising vibration; rising bearing temperature; lubricant degradation. Signals: vibration_mm_s, bearing_temp_c.
source: Industrial X-Ray AI educational knowledge base (non-OEM)

title: Bearing housing (illustrative pump)
text: Bearing housing: Holds the bearings and lubricant; a common mounting point for vibration and temperature sensors. Typical symptoms: lubricant contamination; loose sensor mounting giving poor data. Signals: vibration_mm_s, bearing_temp_c, signal_quality_pct.
source: Industrial X-Ray AI educational knowledge base (non-OEM)

title: Flexible coupling (illustrative pump)
text: Flexible coupling: Connects motor shaft to pump shaft and tolerates small misalignment. Typical symptoms: misalignment → vibration (often axial / 2×); element wear. Signals: vibration_mm_s, motor_current_a.
source: Industrial X-Ray AI educational knowledge base (non-OEM)

title: Electric motor (illustrative pump)
text: Electric motor: Drives the pump; current draw reflects hydraulic load. Typical symptoms: current/load imbalance; overheating; bearing wear. Signals: motor_current_a, bearing_temp_c, vibration_mm_s, speed_rpm.
source: Industrial X-Ray AI educational knowledge base (non-OEM)

title: Baseplate (illustrative pump)
text: Baseplate: Common rigid frame that keeps pump and motor aligned. Typical symptoms: soft foot / loose anchoring → misalignment and vibration. Signals: vibration_mm_s.
source: Industrial X-Ray AI educational knowledge base (non-OEM)
